papers.title: A new genus and species of termitophilous Staphylinidae associated with Rhadinotermes Sands In Rhodesia (Coleoptera)
papers.venue: Journal of the Entomological Society of Southern Africa
papers.abstract: A new genus, Rhadinoxenus, is descriptionbed, illustrated (type-species, Rhadinoxenus pretoriusi spec. nov.), and assigned to the subtribe Termitogastrina tribe Corotocini, subfamily Aleocharinae. The type-species, also new, is descriptionbed from a nest of Rhadinoltrmes coarclatus (Sjoestedt) from the eastern district of Rhodesia. Its relationships with other genera of Term ito gastrin a and the genus Termitochara are discussed.
